bio: Nistoru cannot remember life before becoming Dusklit. In reality, he only comprehend his unstoppable hunger. His life is a blur – first feed on Bloodfruit, and then satiate his cursed armaments by whatever means necessary. In the brief moments of clarity between frenzies, he tries to ensures his next target is deserving of his wrath. But then, the blood urge takes over. The feast cannot end.
